title: Adding a public fluent API function requires updating the top-level export list and generated API inventory together
answers: how do I expose a new function as mlflow.<name>
new fluent API function not available under the top-level mlflow namespace
where to register a new public mlflow function for export
add a fluent wrapper like delete_run to mlflow package exports
body:
Symptom: A new fluent function (e.g. restore_run) works in mlflow.tracking.fluent but is not reachable as mlflow.<name>, or is missing from the API docs.
Root cause: Top-level exports are declared in two places in mlflow/__init__.py (the `from mlflow.tracking.fluent import (...)` block and the `__all__` list); both must list the name. docs/api_reference/api_inventory.txt is generated and lists each public name.
Fix pattern: Implement the function in mlflow/tracking/fluent.py next to its sibling (restore_* placed right after delete_*), add it to the import block and to `__all__` in mlflow/__init__.py, and regenerate api_inventory.txt via the autoformat tooling rather than hand-editing it.
Constraints: Applies to public fluent-API functions in mlflow/tracking/fluent.py. Do not hand-edit api_inventory.txt; it is regenerated. Thin wrappers should only delegate to MlflowClient, with no new backend logic.
applies: Any new public top-level function exposed through the mlflow package namespace.
says: The run restoration command is missing from the main library package namespace.
Cannot access the experiment restore feature directly from the primary package import.
The newly added restore functionality does not appear in the official reference documentation.
Make run and experiment recovery operations available directly at the top level.
search: Exposing a new public fluent API function in mlflow/tracking/fluent.py requires updating both the import block and __all__ in mlflow/__init__.py and regenerating docs/api_reference/api_inventory.txt via autoformat tooling. Sibling functions like restore_run or restore_experiment should be placed adjacent to delete_* functions and act as thin wrappers delegating to MlflowClient without backend logic. The api_inventory.txt file must not be hand-edited.
